title: minor BUG:  automation uses mmo instead of the units selected in preferences until you delete the sample.
symptom: When setting up automation (objective 10), the pre-defined sample rule uses mmol/L units regardless of the user's preference for mg/dl. Even when creating a new automated task while the sample exists, the unit remains mmol/L and cannot be changed. Deleting the sample allows new rules to use the correct units.
cause: The sample rule is created with mmol/L units and changing UI units afterwards does not affect existing rules. The presence of the sample rule seems to cause new rules to also use mmol/L until the sample is deleted.
fix: Delete the provided sample rule, then create a new automated task which will use the correct units (mg/dl).
evidence_quote: if I delete the provided sample, I am then able to create a new automated task which properly uses mg/dl.
